references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, Joshua explains that the stones are to serve as a sign, and that when children ask about the meaning of the stones, fathers should tell them how the Jordan River stopped.
During the Passover celebration in Egypt, the Israelites were instructed to explain the meaning of the ritual to their children when they asked, just as with the memorial stones.
Moses instructed the people to explain to their sons the significance of the firstborn and the deliverance from Egypt when they asked.
In Deuteronomy, similar instructions are given to answer children when they ask about the meaning of the commandments by telling them about the deliverance from Egypt.
The psalm emphasizes the importance of passing on God's deeds to future generations, so that children will know them and tell others.
